xs.$description: New token (2026-10-10), added for Dialog's own panel — the content-measure cap of its smallest size, a short confirmation or a single field. No home on any existing primitive scale (the spacing scale tops out at 8rem).

sm.$description: New token (2026-10-10), Dialog's `sm` panel cap: a short form of a field or two.

md.$description: New token (2026-10-10), Dialog's default panel cap — a typical form or detail view, about 60 characters of body text per line.

lg.$description: New token (2026-10-10), Dialog's `lg` panel cap: a richer form or a content preview that needs two columns.

xl.$description: New token (2026-10-10), Dialog's `xl` panel cap: a wide editor or a table inside a dialog.
